name: Pub/Sub CDC — YugabyteDB → YugabyteDB (embedded Debezium)
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-pubsub-ybdb.sh && echo "" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → pubsub-demo   (guided pub/sub CDC demo)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → pubsub-ws     (Workshop shell for manual commands)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ysql-pub      (YSQL shell → publisher cluster)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ysql-sub      (YSQL shell → subscriber cluster)"'

tasks.label: pubsub-demo
tasks.detail: "The Middleware-less Pipeline" — embedded Debezium applier: snapshot, live INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, atomic transactions (init-pubsub-ybdb/prompt.sh)
tasks.command: cd init-pubsub-ybdb && echo '📡 pubsub-demo  —  Pub/Sub CDC (YugabyteDB → YugabyteDB, no Kafka)' && echo '   Run when ready: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash

tasks.label: pubsub-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for manual pub/sub commands — applier.sh, ysqlsh (init-pubsub-ybdb)
tasks.command: cd init-pubsub-ybdb && echo '📡 pubsub-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual applier.sh and ysqlsh commands here' && exec bash

tasks.label: ysql-pub
tasks.detail: Open a YSQL shell on the PUBLISHER cluster (127.0.0.1) (init-pubsub-ybdb)
tasks.command: echo '🟢 Publisher cluster (127.0.0.1)' && until (echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5433) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done && ysqlsh -h 127.0.0.1

tasks.label: ysql-sub
tasks.detail: Open a YSQL shell on the SUBSCRIBER cluster (127.0.0.11) (init-pubsub-ybdb)
tasks.command: echo '🔵 Subscriber cluster (127.0.0.11)' && until (echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.11/5433) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done && ysqlsh -h 127.0.0.11
